rules.description: A valid candidate draw must span at least 3 distinct decade groups (1-9, 10-19, 20-29, 30-36).
rules.last_journal_note: Rule held true across 91.2% of all historic draws since 2019.

rules.description: The sum of all 5 drawn numbers must fall within the range of 65 to 120.
rules.last_journal_note: Draw sum of 69 validates the lower bound of the 65-120 window; rule remains highly predictive.

rules.description: At least one number from draw D(t-1) carries over to draw D(t).
rules.last_journal_note: When no numbers repeat for 2 consecutive draws, probability of repeat on 3rd draw rises to 68%.

rules.description: The draw contains exactly one adjacent consecutive pair (e.g., 14, 15).
rules.last_journal_note: Clusters of 3+ consecutive numbers (e.g., 29, 30, 31) are capped at a 20% max selection probability.

rules.description: The odd-to-even ratio of selected numbers must be 3:2 or 2:3.
rules.last_journal_note: Draw parity is 3 odd (5, 13, 35) and 2 even (4, 12), adhering perfectly to the 3:2 ratio.
